description: Source code for MPEG2 Program Stream extractor in Android, including class definitions for Track and WrappedTrack, and functions for parsing MPEG2 PS streams.

classes.name: MPEG2PSExtractor::Track
classes.description: Represents a media track within MPEG2 PS stream, manages PES data and format extraction.

classes.name: MPEG2PSExtractor::WrappedTrack
classes.description: A wrapper around Track to manage buffer groups and interface with media source.

methods.name: MPEG2PSExtractor::Track::appendPESData
methods.description: Appends PES packet data to the track, parses timestamps, and queues access units.

methods.name: MPEG2PSExtractor::Track::getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format of the track as an AMediaFormat object.

methods.name: MPEG2PSExtractor::Track::read
methods.description: Reads data from the track, providing buffers with media data and metadata.

methods.name: SniffMPEG2PS
methods.description: Detects MPEG2 PS stream by checking stream header signature and confidence level.
